text:
deploy-bot: Canary failed for release/frontend 3.2.1 -> 3.3.0 in edge-zone-eu-west. Preflight: values-merge-check errored (overlay key conflict). Automatic rollback to 3.2.1 initiated. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/2638001234 :warning:

kevin.h: Ugh, saw that — what overlay key? any quick diff?

maria: Startup diff from helm-dryrun shows the conflict. Short excerpt:
```
# merged values snippet
replicaCount: 2
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 250m
    memory: 512Mi
edgeOverrides:
  enabled: true
  nodeSelector: { zone: "edge-zone-eu-west" }
# but chart default has edgeOverrides.nodeSelector: { zone: "edge-zone-eu-west-v2" }
```

maria: The overlay for the edge pool changed name in chart v3.3.0 -> `edge-zone-eu-west-v2`. The deploy-bot merge rules treated it as two different keys and threw a hard failure.

oliver: So it's a schema/values naming change in the chart, not infra. We can either pin chart to 3.2.1 for this region or add a compatibility migration in the values-merge step.

liz: Priority is to keep customers online. Recommend pinning the release in edge-zone until we ship a quick hotfix. I'll open a pinned release in the release tracker. :white_check_mark:

kevin.h: Agree. Can we do a targeted republish of the values mapping so future canaries succeed? Something like a post-render hook to map `edge-zone-eu-west` -> `edge-zone-eu-west-v2` during merge.

maria: We could add a short legacy alias in the merge service. Quick patch: transform rules in values-merge-config:
```yaml
transformations:
  - if: "has(edgeOverrides.nodeSelector.zone) and edgeOverrides.nodeSelector.zone == 'edge-zone-eu-west'"
    set: "edgeOverrides.nodeSelector.zone = 'edge-zone-eu-west-v2'"
```
This would let 3.3.0 accept old inputs.

oliver: That patch is low-risk. How fast can we ship it? If it's >30m we should pin.

maria: I can test and push a canary of the merge-service in ~20m, then re-run deploy-bot.

liz: OK plan: (1) pin chart promotion for edge-zone in the release tracker to 3.2.1 (temp), (2) maria will push merge-service patch and ask deploy-bot to retry canary, (3) if retry succeeds, unpin and promote 3.3.0 with a note in release notes about values alias.

kevin.h: I'll handle the release-tracker pin and update release notes with the compatibility note.

oncall-bot: FYI runbook snippet triggered: "canary-failure-values-merge". If rollback remains >15m reopen incident page and notify infra-oncall.

maria: Starting local test now — will post logs.

deploy-bot: Retry queued. Waiting on merge-service signal.

maria: Test run finished: merge-service patch OK in staging. Re-run results: canary now passes preflight in staging.

kevin.h: Unpin scheduled once staging-promote completes. I'll also add a short release-note blurb: "Chart v3.3.0 renames edge pool selector; values merge layer accepts legacy selector for a transitional window."

liz: Good. Please ensure ops knows the timing for unpin to avoid double-promotion.

oliver: After unpin we should add an automatic eval that checks for keys with `edgeOverrides.nodeSelector` across regions to catch other naming drift.

maria: Filed GH PR to merge-service: https://git.internal/redwood/merge-service/pulls/456 — includes tests.

kevin.h: Pin posted in release-tracker: https://releases.redwood/internal/track/FE-7890 -> pinned 3.2.1 for edge-zone-eu-west (note: temporary).

liz: Thanks all — reopen here if any retry fails. :rocket:
